text: Implemented byte-preserving AscSourceLine/AscRecord algebra with validated line budgets and locations, retained LF/CRLF/EOF delimiters, explicit printable-ASCII structural policy with first-line UTF-8 BOM handling, exact payload bytes, unknown/malformed-known retention, bounded diagnostics, and private constructors. Evidence: ioJVM and ioJS EyeLinkAscRecordsSuite each pass 12/12; scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck pass. Mutation proof replaced an unknown valid record with Blank and the suite failed at EyeLinkAscRecordsSuite.scala:99, then restoration returned both platforms green.
